title: Blaze the Dragon's Quest
summary: A young dragon learns that true strength comes from helping others when it saves a trapped animal using its special flame.

pages.text: A small black dragon lived in a tall cliff cave.
pages.scene: A young dragon with small flames perched on rocky cliffs

pages.text: Blaze felt trapped and wanted to fly free.
pages.scene: Dragon looking out at the vast world below, longing for adventure

pages.text: One day a cry came from the trees.
pages.scene: A frightened animal sound echoing from the forest below

pages.text: "Please help! I am stuck!" said the frog.
pages.scene: A green frog tangled in thick vines, struggling desperately

pages.text: Blaze flew down fast and quick.
pages.scene: Dragon diving swiftly through the air toward the frog

pages.text: Can you cut the vines? Please!
Blaze's flame was bright and strong, and it cut the vines.
pages.scene: Dragon using precise flames to burn away the tangled vines

pages.text: The frog was free and glad!
pages.scene: Frog leaping away, celebrating its freedom

pages.text: Blaze learned that being a hero meant being kind and brave.
pages.scene: Dragon and frog together, dragon no longer feeling trapped
Dragon flying freely, now with purpose and friendship
